•	Phase 2: maintenance + Asset Management (GMAO).
The call for tenders concerns phase 2: Agile deployment of a CMMS solution. Phase 1 is mentioned as a reminder and to understand all the objectives of the SNT project and to give information for the interfaces of the CMMS.
